title: Create images
description: Describe an image and create it in your browser, with SANA-Sprint. Nothing leaves your device.
intro: Describe an image and create it right here, in your browser, in a few steps. What you write and what you create never leave your device.
catalog.name: Create images
catalog.line: Creates images from a text, in your browser, with shapes, a seed to repeat them and PNG downloads.
prompt.label: What you want to see
prompt.placeholder: A lighthouse on a cliff at sunset, waves crashing against the rocks
prompt.hint: The more specific, the better: the subject, the place, the light and the style. Ctrl or ⌘ + Enter to create it.
aspect.label: Shape
steps.label: Steps
seed.label: Seed
note.language: It understands descriptions in English best; other languages work with less precision.
action.downloadAndRun: Download the model ({size}) and create the image
stage.loading: Preparing the model on the graphics card…
result.truncated: The description was very long: the model only read its beginning.
download.name: {name}-{seed}.png
file.name: image
history.title: Created in this browser
history.note: Kept only here, in this browser. Click one to go back to its description and seed.
error.empty-prompt: First write what you want to see.
error.bad-seed: The seed is a whole number from 0 to 4294967295, or leave it empty.
error.device-unsupported: This graphics card does not offer WebGPU with 16-bit numbers, which the model needs.
unsupported.webgpu-unavailable: This browser does not offer WebGPU, which the model needs. Try Chrome or Edge on a computer.
unsupported.shader-f16: This graphics card does not offer WebGPU with 16-bit numbers, which the model needs. Try another computer.
unsupported.memory: It does not fit on a phone: the model needs more memory than the browser gives one tab. Open it on a computer.
